messages:
marta: heads up, prod deploy for service-api failed during image promotion. deploybot says tag v2.14.0 resolved to a different digest than the one that passed canary :confused:
dev-deploy-bot: deploy blocked — image tag mismatch for repo=redwood/service-api tag=v2.14.0 expected sha256:abc123... got sha256:def456... see /deploy/logs/1712345678
anika: ugh, that sounds like tag drift. did the build pipeline retag on push or did someone re-push the same tag manually?
josh: quick check: `aws ecr describe-images --repository-name redwood/service-api --image-ids imageTag=v2.14.0` shows two entries, one with pushTime 2025-03-02T03:10:12Z. my guess is immutability was off briefly and someone force-pushed.
sre-team: we saw a short ACL change in the ECR repo policy that allowed a CI runner to re-push yesterday 22:00 UTC. suspected root cause: temporary credential rotation script failed and reverted a prior policy change.
mantra (marta): we need a short remediation plan. rolling back the deploy won't help because the tag no longer maps to the original digest in the registry. options: 1) retag the stable digest to v2.14.0 (if we still have the artifact), 2) pin deploy to digest for this rollout, 3) block further tag-based promotes until immutability is enforced.
anika: do we have the original digest? buildkite artifacts show `sha256:abc123` for the canary run. ops-pr-bot: opened PR #612 to pin manifest digests in the release job (link: https://git.redwood/ops/repo/pulls/612).
josh: short-term: I'm going to retag the correct digest to a temporary tag `promote-safe-1712345678` and update deploybot to use that. longer-term: enable ECR immutability and disallow overwrites.
sre-team: agree on both. schedule change window? we should do immutable->enforce at low-traffic window and update documentation. propose tonight 02:30–03:00 UTC.
marta: OK. action items: josh retag and update this deploy to use digest or promote-safe tag (today), ops-pr-bot will merge the pin-digest job PR after review, sre-team will enable immutability in the repo and add policy to deny pushes that overwrite tags, dev-deploy-bot to add a pre-publish check to fail if tag resolves to multiple digests.
anika: also can we add a deploybot guard that requires digest or semver+sha label? otherwise humans will keep force-pushing.
ops-pr-bot: PR #613 created to add `--image-digest` flag to the release CLI and update the promotion job docs.
josh: command I'm running now (retag):
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/service-api --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abc123 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text | aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/service-api --image-tag promote-safe-1712345678 --image-manifest file://-
```
please don't run anything else against that repo until we enforce immutability.
sre-team: will apply immutability and push a policy change in a canary repo first, then prod. will post update when done.
marta: thanks everyone — I'll hold the release window until we confirm the tag/digest state. ping here when retag + immutability are complete :thumbsup:
dev-deploy-bot: update: blocked deploy requeued with `image:sha256:abc123` at 1712345705 — manual promotion required.
